inspiration.observed_pattern: A NATURAL JOIN makes shared columns available as one unqualified result column while matching on every shared name.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized to two independently authored tables sharing id and zone_code. One matching pair must return both shared columns unqualified, while a same-id row with a different zone_code must not join.

fixture_notes: Only id 1 matches because both id and zone_code agree; id 2 is rejected because its zone_code differs.
determinism_notes: Two fixed rows are selected in id order. There are no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE natural_left (id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, left_value VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE natural_right (id INT NOT NULL, zone_code VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, right_value VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT id, zone_code, left_value, right_value FROM natural_left NATURAL JOIN natural_right ORDER BY id

checks.sql: SELECT id, zone_code, left_value FROM natural_left ORDER BY id
SELECT id, zone_code, right_value FROM natural_right ORDER BY id
